reused_admitted_method_semantics.crossover: one-point crossover on sorted unique zero-based candidate indices
reused_admitted_method_semantics.duplicate_repair: sort, retain unique valid indices, then use the admitted counter-keyed candidate-wide rejection sampler until free candidates refill the layout, and sort
reused_admitted_method_semantics.geometry_mutation: one selected turbine per evaluated child is replaced uniformly from its five nearest free candidates
reused_admitted_method_semantics.survival: deterministic best-50 AEP from parents plus evaluated offspring
reused_admitted_method_semantics.rng: counter-keyed and independent of worker scheduling

physical_fes.unit: one complete layout evaluation across the selected case's twelve joint wind states
physical_fes.initialization: the first 50 complete layout evaluations consume the first 50 physical FES
physical_fes.terminal_batch: evaluate exactly the remaining number of offspring when fewer than 50 physical FES remain
physical_fes.paper_boundary: The paper reports 50 x 200 = 10000 evaluations but does not resolve whether initialization is extra; this profile stops at exactly the requested total.

execution.default_workers: all hardware threads visible to the job
parallel_stages: offspring construction, repair, and geometric mutation

claim_boundary: The admitted operators are reused on a new declared P3 problem. This is not an original Anholt execution, result, or actual-layout comparison.
